name: HEA-01 - Grace follows up after the 6-week clinic visit

name: HEA-02 - Faith checks every small decision

Quick rule you can own: dress baby in one more layer than feels right for you, and check his neck, if it's sweaty he's too warm.", "created_at": "2026-06-11T14:53:39Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Ok the light one. And for the walk, 20 minutes or is 30 too long?", "created_at": "2026-06-11T14:55:52Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Either is fine, truly. There's no medical line between 20 and 30 minutes, follow his mood and yours.", "created_at": "2026-06-11T14:57:05Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Ok 20 to be safe. You see I always ask you first before I do anything with him. My husband laughs at me but I feel safer when you decide.", "created_at": "2026-06-11T14:59:18Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "I'm glad to be here, but I want to say something kindly: in the months I've known you, your instincts have been right every single time. What would you have done if I wasn't here today?", "created_at": "2026-06-11T15:01:31Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Maybe waited and watched the sneezing? But I prefer not to guess. I will message you when we are back so you tell me if his nap timing is ok.", "created_at": "2026-06-11T15:07:10Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Enjoy the walk, Faith.", "created_at": "2026-06-11T15:09:23Z"}]
description: AI health assistant - Faith, mother of a 3-month-old, Nairobi. Session 12 with this user.

name: HEA-03 - Naliaka and the porridge question
transcript: [{"role": "assistant", "content": "Habari Naliaka! Last time we talked about your plan to breastfeed exclusively until 6 months, and the pressure at home to start porridge early. How has the week been?", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:30:00Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Habari. It is still my goal, six months only breast milk. You planned to explain why you're waiting on the porridge.", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:34:26Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "I tried to explain like you said, that his stomach is not ready. She listened but Thursday she was carrying him and she gave him small porridge anyway. I was washing at the river.", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:36:39Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "I didn't fight her. She raised seven children, she knows things also.", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:38:52Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "That's a hard spot, between respect and your plan. One porridge feed won't harm him, so no need for alarm. Going forward, what feels possible for you?", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:40:05Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Maybe I take him with me to the river? Or I ask my husband to speak to her. Which one is better, you tell me.", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:42:18Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Both can work. Involving your husband often helps because it stops being 'daughter-in-law versus mother-in-law'. And if porridge happens again despite everything, you haven't failed, you just keep the breast feeds frequent and we continue.", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:48:57Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Ok. Yes, that's true.", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:50:10Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Thank you, I feel more prepared now. Asante sana.", "created_at": "2026-06-13T19:52:23Z"}]
description: AI health assistant - Naliaka, mother of a 3-month-old, Bungoma. Session 5 with this user.

name: HEA-06 - Zawadi challenges the iron tablets
transcript: [{"role": "assistant", "content": "Habari Zawadi! Checking in on the week. Were you able to continue with the daily iron and folate tablets?", "created_at": "2026-06-20T09:55:00Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "I stopped them. I know you will say don't stop but those tablets make me want to vomit the whole morning. I could not even work. So before you repeat the same advice, know that I already tried it your way for two weeks.", "created_at": "2026-06-20T09:57:13Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Thank you for telling me straight instead of just stopping quietly. Nausea from iron tablets is real and common. Options: take them at night with food instead of morning, or ask the clinic about a different formulation. And iron-rich foods can help alongside.", "created_at": "2026-06-20T09:59:26Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Night with food, that one nobody told me. Ok I can try that. Which foods, and don't tell me meat every day, meat is for people with money.", "created_at": "2026-06-20T10:01:39Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Fair. Affordable iron: beans, ndengu, dark leafy greens like mchicha, dried small fish like omena, and eating them with a squeeze of lime or fruit helps the iron absorb.", "created_at": "2026-06-20T10:03:52Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Omena and mchicha we have. Beans also. So I do those daily and the tablet at night. If the vomiting comes back I stop the tablets again, I am telling you now.", "created_at": "2026-06-20T10:05:05Z"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Deal, and if it does come back, we escalate to the clinic for an alternative rather than going without. When is your next ANC visit?", "created_at": "2026-06-20T10:07:18Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Supposed to be next week but honestly I don't want to go. Your options: go early morning when it's less crowded, ask for a different nurse, or the facility in Mtwapa which some mothers say is kinder, though it's further.", "created_at": "2026-06-20T10:11:44Z"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Maybe. The food plan and night tablet I will do, that one is in my hands at least. The clinic, we will see.", "created_at": "2026-06-20T10:17:23Z"}]
description: AI health assistant - Zawadi, first pregnancy, 6 months, Kilifi. Session 4 with this user.
